title: Witten's Asymptotic Expansion Conjecture for SU(2) WRT Invariants
exact_target: Do SU(2) quantum invariants of every closed three-manifold have complete large-level expansions assembled from its flat-connection Chern–Simons phases?

sources.citation: Jorgen Ellegaard Andersen, Li Han, Yong Li, William Elbaek Mistegard, David Sauzin and Shanzhong Sun, A proof of Witten's asymptotic expansion conjecture for WRT invariants of Seifert fibered homology spheres (2025).
